question: In a four-player game, one of my creatures has been goaded by two of my three opponents. Can it attack either of those two goading opponents?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it must attack the opponent that has not goaded it, which meets the most goad requirements.
expected.answer: If a creature you control has been goaded by multiple opponents, it must attack one of your opponents that hasn't goaded it, as that fulfills the maximum number of goad requirements. If a creature you control has been goaded by each of your opponents, you choose which opponent it attacks.
